title: Network intrusion detection
summary: Attack F1 was 0.986 on 343,043 held-out Friday flows from corrected CICIDS2017. DDoS was detected consistently, while Bot and PortScan recall were low. On a separate 30,000-flow comparison, the plain Transformer achieved 0.951 attack F1, versus 0.937 with WGAN augmentation.

title: Multimodal deepfake detection
summary: Visual AUROC was 0.580 on 20 held-out clips from a small identity-separated Celeb-DF-v2 subset. The audio-visual variant had too few labeled clips with audio for evaluation.

title: Knee X-ray bone density classification
summary: EfficientNet-B3 features with an SVM reached 0.438 macro F1 on 210 images, compared with 0.334 for the handcrafted SVM under subject-grouped cross-validation. Minority-class performance was low. Research benchmark only.
